race.comment: GUNAI ASH (1) looks close to another win after hitting the frame in a 2.25 lengths second (22.43) in a Grade 7 at this track. Form from her last run is proving strong. Can measure up this time. SHOOTERS PROJECT (7) turned in a better effort at this track last start, finishing second behind Nightmare Swifty (22.55) in a Grade 6. Has the early speed to land on the pace and can stick on. The form from his last run stacks up well. Bold showing expected. ENERGY KISS (8) was sent out at odds but pinged the lids and never headed leading all the way to score by 4 lengths (22.50) at this track in Rank Limit - Grade 7 over 390m. Has never been out of the money in three starts this distance. Expected to feature again.
